title: Design System: St Marys Village Dry Cleaners

display.purpose: Hero h1 only; carries the butter-colored emphasis word.

title.purpose: Component headings: service-tile h3, process-step h3, why-list h3, accordion trigger, reviews-facts h3.

label.purpose: Uppercase small labels: contact-label, footer headers, brand-sub.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for service tiles, contact-list rows, hours-matrix, gallery items, scrolled header.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Hover elevation for gallery items; resting elevation for header-cta and map-badge.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: The floating trust-card, featured service tile, story/why media frames, contact-map frame.

shadows.name: shadow-dark
shadows.purpose: The fixed call affordance and the why-media frame — elements that must float over any background.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for nearly all transitions.

motion.name: reveal-on-scroll
motion.purpose: Section content fade/rise on first scroll into view.

motion.name: pulse-ring
motion.purpose: Keeps the fixed Call affordance alive without being a loud animation; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cream-filled CTA for use on dark backgrounds (hero, why, final-cta).
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em; padding: 1em 1.9em; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.98rem; min-height: 48px; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), background-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary { background: #FFF8EE; color: #0E3527; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -12px rgba(22,40,32,0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 26px 60px -18px rgba(22,40,32,0.28); }

components.name: Primary Dark Button
components.description: Forest-deep filled CTA for use on light backgrounds (services, contact).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em; padding: 1em 1.9em; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.98rem; min-height: 48px; background: #164D3A; color: #FFF8EE; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(22,40,32,0.12); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), background 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary-dark:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #0E3527; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -12px rgba(22,40,32,0.2); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Coral-bordered outline CTA for light backgrounds; text uses coral-ink, never raw coral, for contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em; padding: 1em 1.9em; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.98rem; min-height: 48px; background: transparent; color: #B9502F; border: 1.5px solid #EF795D; transition: background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { background: #EF795D; color: #FFF8EE; }

components.name: Featured Service Tile
components.description: Full-bleed photo tile with a bottom gradient scrim and cream text overlaid directly on the image — the system's one editorial magazine-spread technique. Tag badge sits on the photo itself, never above the heading.
components.html:
Most Popular

Professional Dry Cleaning

components.css: .ds-service-featured { position: relative; border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 26px 60px -18px rgba(22,40,32,0.28); min-height: 360px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; } .ds-service-featured img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; z-index: 0; } .ds-service-featured::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(14,53,39,0.92) 0%, rgba(14,53,39,0.5) 45%, transparent 75%); } .ds-service-tag { position: absolute; top: 1.2rem; left: 1.2rem; z-index: 2; background: #F4DB92; color: #0E3527; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.4em 0.9em; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-service-featured-copy { position: relative; z-index: 2; padding: 2rem; max-width: 560px; } .ds-service-featured-copy h3 { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 2rem; color: #FFF8EE; } .ds-service-featured-copy p { margin-top: 0.8rem; font-size: 1.02rem; color: #CFE0D6; }

components.name: Why List Item
components.description: Plain marked list item for Why Choose Us (dark forest-deep section): a small coral dot, not an icon-in-a-circle or a bordered card — deliberately avoiding the generic 4-card grid pattern.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-why-item { display: flex; gap: 1.1rem; } .ds-why-mark { flex-shrink: 0; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #EF795D; margin-top: 0.5rem; } .ds-why-item h3 { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.15rem; color: #FFF8EE; } .ds-why-item p { margin-top: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #CFE0D6; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Reviews Pull Stat
components.description: Large pulled rating stat paired with a plain top-rule-divided facts list, instead of a card grid, because no individually-attributed review text could be sourced.

components.css: .ds-reviews-score { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 4.5rem; color: #164D3A; line-height: 1; } .ds-reviews-count { font-size: 0.95rem; color: #585B52; font-weight: 600; } .ds-reviews-facts li { padding-top: 1.3rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(37,40,35,0.12); } .ds-reviews-facts h3 { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.15rem; color: #252823; } .ds-reviews-facts p { margin-top: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #585B52; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Contact List Row
components.description: Paper row with box-shadow-only elevation (no border) and a 48x48px-minimum copy-to-clipboard button.
components.html: • Phone02 9673 3934
components.css: .ds-contact-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1rem; background: #FFFFFF; padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(22,40,32,0.12); list-style: none; } .ds-contact-icon { flex-shrink: 0; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #DCE9D9; color: #164D3A; } .ds-contact-label { display: block; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8B8D82; } .ds-contact-body a { font-weight: 600; color: #252823; } .ds-copy-btn { flex-shrink: 0; padding: 0.5em 1em; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: #8B8D82; border: 1px solid rgba(37,40,35,0.18); min-height: 48px; min-width: 48px; background: none; }

components.name: Accordion Item
components.description: Borderless FAQ row with a hairline divider, a rotating +/x icon built from CSS pseudo-elements (never a glyph), and a grid-rows expand animation.
components.html: Call or email us, or drop by in person.
components.css: .ds-accordion-item { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(37,40,35,0.14); } .ds-accordion-trigger { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 1.5rem 0.2rem; font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.15rem; color: #252823; min-height: 48px; } .ds-faq-icon { position: relative; width: 22px; height: 22px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-faq-icon::before, .ds-faq-icon::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; background: #164D3A; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-faq-icon::before { width: 14px; height: 2px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } .ds-faq-icon::after { width: 2px; height: 14px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } .ds-accordion-trigger[aria-expanded='true'] .ds-faq-icon::after { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(90deg); opacity: 0; } .ds-accordion-panel { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr; overflow: hidden; transition: grid-template-rows 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-accordion-item.is-open .ds-accordion-panel { grid-template-rows: 1fr; } .ds-accordion-panel > p { overflow: hidden; min-height: 0; color: #585B52; line-height: 1.65; }

narrative.overview: This system reads as an editorial fabric-care spread, not a generic local-service grid: large image-led tiles stand in for icon-plus-heading cards, and a deliberate multi-hue section rhythm (forest green, ivory, sage, peach, cream, near-black) paces the page like a magazine rather than a flat single-background scroll. A visitor opens on a dark forest-green hero with a duotone-treated garment photograph, then moves through alternating light and dark registers — each section change is a page turn, not a repeated card pattern. Real photography, a real four-step drop-off process, and the sourced TrueLocal rating carry the trust work; nothing is invented to fill a gap. This replaces "The Lit Counter" (amber/charcoal, glassmorphism nav, bento-grid cards) in full. The two systems are deliberately incompatible by design: this world uses flat image-led tiles instead of bento-span cards, a plain-marked list instead of an icon-circle grid for Why Choose Us and Reviews, and a different serif voice (DM Serif Display, never bold — it has no bold cut) in place of Playfair Display, specifically so the page reads as a genuine new identity rather than a palette reskin. Confirmed visual rejections carried through finish review: no kicker/eyebrow label above any heading anywhere on the page (a "Most Popular" tag briefly drifted into that position above the featured service tile during build and was relocated onto the photo itself before ship); no card pairs a resting border with a box-shadow ("ghost card"); no generic 4-card icon grid for Why Choose Us or Reviews (the user's brief explicitly banned the pattern); no invented testimonial text (TrueLocal blocks scraping individual reviews, so only the sourced aggregate rating is shown).
keyCharacteristics: A 12-section alternating light/dark/light background rhythm (forest-deep -> ivory -> sage -> forest-deep -> peach -> cream -> ivory -> sage -> ivory -> forest-deep -> ink) that paces the page, not a flat repeated surface
One large full-bleed "featured" service tile with cream text overlaid directly on a photo under a gradient scrim — a distinct editorial technique, never repeated on the other six supporting tiles
Shadow-only elevation everywhere; no card ever pairs a resting border with a box-shadow
Two sections (Why Choose Us, Reviews) deliberately use a plain marked/divided list instead of a card grid, by brief and by necessity (no individually-attributed review text exists)
DM Serif Display (weight 400 only, never bold) paired with Manrope — a different serif voice from the superseded system, chosen to make the replacement unmistakable

rules.name: The Section Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Section background color is a deliberate pacing device, not a flat repeat: hero/why/final-cta/footer are dark (forest-deep, forest-deep-to-forest-dark, or ink), services/reviews/faq are ivory, process/contact are sage, storytelling is peach alone, gallery is cream. No two adjacent sections in the stack share the same background.

rules.name: The Coral-Ink Split Rule
rules.body: Raw coral (#EF795D) is reserved for stars, markers, borders, and large decorative elements. Any coral used as readable text or a link on a light background uses coral-ink (#B9502F) instead, to clear contrast — the two are never interchangeable.

rules.name: The No-Bold-Serif Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display has no bold cut in the loaded weight set; every display/headline/title use in the system is weight 400. Emphasis within a serif heading is carried by color (the butter hero word) or italic, never by faking a bold weight.

rules.name: The Shadow-Only Elevation Rule
rules.body: A card or raised surface declares elevation via box-shadow alone, at rest and on hover. No surface pairs a border with a box-shadow for the same edge. Verified directly in the build: .contact-list li, .hours-matrix, and .service-tile-media all carry box-shadow with no accompanying border property.

dos: Do alternate section background across the full page stack so no two adjacent sections share a color (The Section Rhythm Rule).
Do elevate every card/raised surface with box-shadow alone, never a border-plus-shadow pair (The Shadow-Only Elevation Rule).
Do use coral-ink, not raw coral, for any text or link on a light background; reserve raw coral for stars, dots, and borders (The Coral-Ink Split Rule).
Do position any service-tile tag badge on the photo itself, never in the text column above a heading.
Do keep DM Serif Display at weight 400 everywhere; it has no bold cut (The No-Bold-Serif Rule).
Do keep every interactive control (buttons, copy buttons, nav toggle, fixed call) at a 48x48px minimum touch target.
Do use a plain marked/divided list instead of a card grid for Why Choose Us and Reviews; do not default to a 4-card icon grid.
donts: Don't place a kicker/eyebrow label above any heading anywhere on the page — this was caught and fixed in this build's own finish review and must not recur.
Don't invent review content, star counts, pricing, or years-in-business figures in any new copy; Reviews shows only the sourced TrueLocal aggregate, linked out.
Don't add a booking/scheduling form to the Contact section; the business is walk-in/drive-up only (see PRODUCT.md) and this is a brand-truth constraint, not a stylistic choice.
Don't achieve service-tile visual variety via grid-column/grid-row spanning; use fixed tiles with varied image aspect-ratios instead, to avoid the empty-cell bug class found earlier in this project.
Don't carry over any token, color, or component from the superseded "Lit Counter" system (amber palette, Playfair Display, glassmorphism bento cards); this is a full replacement, not a merge.
